summary.text: Chuck Horst (Charles Horst Sr.) is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 95, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner who previously worked as an automotive technician and operated an engine repair shop.

paragraphs.text: Charles Horst Sr. lives in Falling Waters, West Virginia, and his career experience includes working as an automotive technician and owning and operating an engine repair shop.
Ballotpedia lists Horst's tenure in the House of Delegates as beginning in 2020, and he has represented District 95 since December 1, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
